findings.title: A named correction of the latest break that omits its first day crashes the new re-read (recordedStop) and leaves every later review in HOLD

evidence.reproduction: Founder's case (holiday kept, weeks 4-5 with every run done and the Friday strength missed, trip Mon-Thu wk6 named, plain review: REESTABLISH, holiday OWN_RETURN). Then RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE naming the trip with {endDate, days:5, reasonCategory, reason, nonclinical} and no startDate (probes/qre-p34-q01.mjs case a; qre-p34-runtime.mjs Q01).
evidence.candidate: HOLD, status HOLD, planValidity REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION, errors ['malformed:RangeError'], reason 'Malformed review facts: Invalid time value'. The next plain review and the week's review HOLD the same way; only a restatement with its startDate recovers. A correction stating only its length (no first or last day) HOLDs too (case b). The record is kept (23 rows).
evidence.R7D-FREEZE-4: the same inputs REESTABLISH (SHORT 5; it drops the holiday: the F02 defect this phase fixes), then KEEP.
evidence.control: the same correction shape after a single-break return behaves identically on both runtimes (case c).
evidence.rootCause: recordedStop builds the head as {start: head.start, ...}; readBreak returns start=null when the report gives no startDate (and no startedAt), which the R7-A interface accepts and returnAfterPause handles (pauseStart = start ?? onDate(end, -(days-1))). stopOf then calls onDate(null,-1): new Date(NaN).toISOString() throws RangeError, caught by evaluateProgram's try/catch as HOLD. The correction's declaration stays on the record, so each later review re-reads it and throws again. separateStop already defaults the same field: head.start ?? onDate(head.end, -(head.days-1)).
evidence.scratchFixCheck: with start: head.start ?? onDate(head.end, -(head.days-1)) in recordedStop's head (scratch qre-p34-fixcheck-*, never applied to the repository): directed 76/76; the correction without startDate REESTABLISHes, its view equals the correction with startDate, no later HOLD (probes/out/qre-p34-*.scratch-fix-check.json).

No harness property detects it (no return is applied).
findings.requiredFix: Default the head's first day in recordedStop exactly as separateStop does, plus a directed test RED on 1978cc4 (CQ-1). No other runtime byte.

correctness.reentryBetween: Correct against BR-Q4 and BR-Q5: counted runs are the gated roles (complete() needs at least one gate key, so no vacuous completion) plus RACE_TOUCH and RACE finished, not ADVERSE or CONFLICTING, observed before the cut; every strength exercise ADVANCE or EARNED with a log; optional WALK, RECOVERY_EASY, SHAKEOUT and strides never decide; a session on the later break's first day is between only with a stated startedAt and is read through the history cut at that instant; full = first week complete in every sport it plans, sport = first week per sport. Day-precision reports get the end of their local day as observedAt (or the report clock on that day), so 'startedAt without observed times' is never counted before a later start unless the report itself came before it. Untested edges: QRE-P34-04 (Q02-Q04, Q12).
correctness.ownReturnOf: Correct against BR-Q1.3: x's own stop is stopOf over x and the remaining earlier breaks (recursion), its class by its own stop's days (QH3: merged with a touching break, MODERATE 14), its entry by the unchanged recipe with no demonstration, its point the local midnight after x's last day, fromWeek from that day. It is a reading only: it adds no decision or row; the latest return records it in separateBreaks.
correctness.stateForStop: Correct against BR-Q3: without an own return it is stateAtBreak; with one, each sport reads x's own return injected into decisions, except a re-entered sport, which reads its executed history; material is the OR of both readings. stateAtBreak selects the return in force by end date and passes it explicitly, so the appended position of the reconstructed decision does not mislead it. P34-M3/M4 and my Q13 kill the per-sport errors.
correctness.recordedStop: Defective for a head without a first day (QRE-P34-01). Otherwise correct: it re-reads every non-LATEST row of the recorded return from the carried declarations by the same stopOf, asks when a declaration is missing or changed (O4; untested, Q09), keeps R-F08-1 as unreachable defence (Q05), and is used only when the return listed separate breaks (and, for staleReturn, only when it listed an OWN_RETURN).
correctness.stopOf: Correct order per BR-Q1: touching or overlapping breaks merge; a full re-entry week makes the break TRAINING_AFTER; otherwise unreported sessions between are asked first; otherwise a one-sport week, with no applied return between, makes it OWN_RETURN (loop ends; earlier breaks are WITHIN_OWN_RETURN with their placement inside it); otherwise continuity. declared lists the stop, every unplaced break and the OWN_RETURN break as known stops. Deterministic: the sort is a total order on (end, start) and stable otherwise.
correctness.appliedBetween: Correct (QE-R7D-P33-03): with an applied return whose interruption lies between, nothing is reconstructed; the continuity stop then spans that applied return, and interruptionEpisode always asks (afterReentry of the applied return cannot hold for a start before its end). Killed by T20 (my Q01).
correctness.returnEntryReturnClass: Behaviour-preserving: returnClass is the old expression; returnEntry contains the old MODERATE (EASY and WALK_JOG) and LONG branches verbatim in the same order, with strength by returnStrength and the demonstration minutes passed in; the call site computes demoMinutes before it as before. The differential shows no single-break case changed.
correctness.staleReturn: Correct (CF-P34-04): an OWN_RETURN return is rebuilt from its record (recordedStop, onlyOwnReturn) and compared through the same per-sport state; T10 shows no spurious question, T13 a genuine late fact asked; my Q04 (the two long runs between corrected to not done after the return): ASK interruption.episodeId, where the fresh read of that record is continuity LONG 32 RESTART.
correctness.episodeClinical: Correct: keptBreaks marks an episode clinical when any of its reports screens clinical; the review carries the route under a Symbol on a shallow copy, which clinicalRoute uses only when the stated reason does not screen clinical; the conformance anchor is untouched. The Symbol is never serialized or hashed: the same review twice is byte-identical, the output holds no trace of it, and inputHash still hashes the input (Q07). T12 covers P1, P3, P4, a trip, a schedule change and a weekly review; QRE-P34-07 lists the two pre-existing unread paths.
correctness.composeWeeksCeiling: Correct (SSCTR-P34-F01): the weeks after a return's own week no longer credit that week's sessions dated before the return (C5's beforeReturn, as conditionalNext already read them). The change can only remove references from a max, so it never raises a ceiling: independently, across all 165 corpus cases, R7D-FREEZE-4 against a ceiling-only hybrid differs in exactly the 6 decomposition cases, with 0 run sessions raised and 0 strength rows changed. T16 and T20 (G1-G4) pin it for the return itself; Q14 and Q15 shapes are untested.

edgeCases.threeOrMoreBreaks: T8 (three breaks, no WITHIN row). My QH2 and QH3 (one level of WITHIN_OWN_RETURN) are correct and pass the harness; QH1 (two levels) is correct in the runtime but false-blocked by P18(a) (QRE-P34-02) and thinly recorded (QRE-P34-03).
edgeCases.sportWithNoCountedSession: No vacuous completion (complete() needs a gate key or an exercise). A week whose running is only optional recovery runs never completes running and so never a full week (QRE-P34-06, routed).
edgeCases.skippedSessions: SKIPPED sessions leave the week as the reducer does (no debt); a week with every strength session skipped is a full week (QRE-P34-05, routed; pre-existing).
edgeCases.lateOrConflictedReports: Late corrections that remove the own week are asked (Q04); a conflicted report between is asked as unreported (Phase 3.3 T4, updated). Conflicted or late race reports: correct by code, untested (Q03, Q04).
edgeCases.startedAtWithoutObservedTimes: Correct by code and BR-Q5 (see reentryBetween); the no-startedAt same-day rule is correct (O2) but untested (Q12).
edgeCases.runOnlyStrengthOnlyPlans: T19: only a whole week of the one sport re-enters; one session missed is continuity, never an own return.
edgeCases.correctionsTouchOverlapMove: T21 covers one day longer, touching, overlapping, a week moved out (asked) and a week moved in (asked). A correction without its first day crashes (QRE-P34-01).
edgeCases.replays: T10: the same correction twice applies nothing (KEEP); a later plain review after the own return is not asked again.

answers.determinismAndAppendOnly: T11 (both declarations and every session between stay, the return applied once, the same review twice byte-identical, either declaration order the same stop and plan) and Q07. The HOLD of QRE-P34-01 keeps the record (out is spread into the HOLD). The reconstruction never becomes a fact. Event separation: a break carried by another event is still asked (T12 schedule change is routed clinically with no change applied).

containment.changeSurface: By code reading, the adaptation change acts only when (1) two or more separate unapplied breaks are on record (separateStop/stopOf, with the race keys and the same-day rule inside reentryBetween), (2) a named report of the latest episode whose return listed separate breaks (recordedStop), (3) a late-evidence check of a return that listed an OWN_RETURN (staleReturn), (4) a kept episode with a clinical report (keptBreaks/EPISODE_CLINICAL); the refactor is behaviour-preserving; the composition change acts only when a re-planned week holds the latest return. Nothing else can change.
containment.differentialAndDecomposition: Sound for what they claim, with stated limits: the triggers are necessary conditions read on a run, not causes; the decomposition is one path (R7D-FREEZE-4 -> hybrid -> candidate), so an interaction masked on that path is not separated (none is plausible: the composition change uses only beforeReturn and returned, both already in R7D-FREEZE-4's composition, and no new adaptation export). My independent ceiling probe confirms the ceiling-only set and its monotonicity.
containment.hybridFair: Yes: it differs from R7D-FREEZE-4 in r6-composition.mjs only and from the candidate in r6-adaptation.mjs only (the script checks both), and the composition change is self-contained.

harnessRevision.P18a: A sound necessary condition again for TRAINING_AFTER (counted sessions executed, the stop's first day with startedAt), OWN_RETURN (some sport's whole week, ownReturn ending with the break) and one level of WITHIN_OWN_RETURN (QH2, QH3), matching the runtime's week set (live = prescribed, not SKIPPED). Not at two levels (QRE-P34-02).
harnessRevision.P18c: A sound sufficient reading by construction: stricter than the gates (completed, not partial/conflicted/confounded/superseded, every response stated and nominal, minutes at least prescribed, strength sets/reps/RIR/load at least prescribed), strict before the next break's first day, top-level continuity rows only. It can miss inverse defects it cannot read as nominal (disclosed). The guard case ends in a question, so no applied return is checked there.
harnessRevision.P08: The alignment is correct and narrow: it adds a run on the break's first day only when the break states startedAt and the report was observed before it, mirroring BR-Q5 and the runtime's cut; W-P08c keeps a run after the start binding. It does not weaken the oracle beyond the rule.
harnessRevision.P06b: A sound necessary condition: its allowed references are the completed runs in the window plus every own-week session from the return day on, a superset of what the runtime credits. It checks the return step only (Q15 shapes are outside it).
harnessRevision.P18d: Cannot false-block the re-read design (the re-read lists every recorded break again, or the new stop covers it); it detects P34-M7 and the partial-record mutant Q09 when such a trace exists.
harnessRevision.P02: Sound for the R-F08-1 outcome on the client's step forms; see QRE-P34-08 for refused-unread steps.
harnessRevision.DEV42to45AndWitnesses: Adequate controls for what they target (race touch missed, missing RIR, startedAt after or before the Sunday long run). Missing controls this check found: two-level own returns (QRE-P34-02), an adverse or conflicting race, a same-day session without startedAt, a post-event recovery week, a skipped-sport week.
harnessRevision.couldBlockACorrectHoldout: Yes: P18(a) on a two-level own-return chain (QH1, demonstrated); P02 theoretically (QRE-P34-08, not reachable through the current client).

adequacy.directedTests: 31 tests, strong on the main shapes (Founder's case against E1, per sport both ways, RIR, adverse runs, unreported, late form, recursion, clinical first, corrections and replay, determinism, R-F08-1, I6, race weeks, walks, same day, ceiling, R1/R1b/R2, E4/V3/W4/X6, single-sport plans, different weeks, guard, L1, C3, G1-G4, T21). RED reproduced: 22/31 fail on R7D-FREEZE-4, 9 characterization pass. Gaps: QRE-P34-04.
adequacy.mutation: The author's 13/13 stand. My 17 complementary mutants: 3 killed, 5 equivalent or unreachable, 3 observable survivors no test kills even in the full suite (Q02, Q09, Q12), 6 more untested or not demonstrated observable.
adequacy.updatedAssertions: Accepted. Each of the five encodes the new reading and adds checks (own class and days, sports re-entered, run mode, both declarations kept, no return), dropping none; each fails on the other runtime in both directions (reproduced: exactly these five). Phase 3.2 T5 is the marked R-F08-1 change PCG-F08-C03(c) requires.

answers.noNewNumberEngineeringView: The runtime diff adds no policy constant: its new literals are date arithmetic (one day, minutes to milliseconds, days to weeks) and one structural row count (a recorded return lists at least LATEST and one other break). The domain judgement of CF-P34-09 is the SSCTR's.

freezeReadiness.freezeScript: freeze-r7d-5.mjs (read at HEAD 3f876a0, where only its header comment differs from 1978cc4) refuses on every condition it lists, requires READY or READY_WITH_CONDITIONS from this record and a candidate prefix matching --reviewed, checks src/test/harness lib against the reviewed commit, binds this folder's .mjs/.json/.md files, and writes one record with flag 'wx'. It cannot freeze 1978cc4 on this record (verdict NOT_READY). Minor: the reviewed-commit equality covers harness/lib and r7d-harness.mjs but not harness/validation scripts or README, which are bound by hash only.
freezeReadiness.verifyScript: verify-r7d-5.mjs is read-only unless --write, which writes only VERIFICATION_R7D_5.json.
freezeReadiness.queueScript: integrate-queue-r7d-p33.mjs checks before writing (round-trip, 234 items, no duplicate, scientific content unchanged except queue_id, target runtime and owner, funding unchanged), all of which hold today (read-only check).
